notes: One row per provider (provider_approval_number). entity_form is a conservative classification of Legal Name by suffix and keyword; it is a heuristic, not a legal determination. Names are withheld fail closed (CLAUDE.md rule 2): legal_name and trading_name are null and name_withheld is true unless there is positive evidence of an organisation: a legal form in the name (Pty Ltd, Ltd, Limited, Inc, Incorporated, Co-operative, Corporation), a government form, or a non-individual ABR entity type from an accepted ABN match. An institutional word alone is not evidence. Person signals (individual trustees, estates, trusts named after a person) withhold the name whatever the evidence. Addresses are not carried over. service_count joins on provider_approval_number in the services table; providers with no services in that table have service_count 0, which is not evidence that they operate none.
